dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Uh, what do you mean? I haven't seen anything odd...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: What shall we do later? Should we try racing to see who can get from the town to the big boat faster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I haven't got time for that at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it, you're one of those "people with things to do," like my dad and mom.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Grandpa says that you shouldn't trouble people like that, so I won't bother you anymore. I'll play by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I'm very good at that — even playing by myself can be a super fun thing!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Well, I guess it's Super Fun Thing Number 2. Number 1 is when Navia comes around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do your best.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't wanna race me? Alright then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Big Sis Navia...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: She's the one the adults call the Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: But that sounds super serious. Makes her sound like some old guy smacking tables and yelling at people — that doesn't seem like Navia at all!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Whenever she's around, the town's a super lively place. Even the grown-ups laugh and are happy.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Sometimes she even brings some amazing clockwork toys back for Granny Yvette to look at.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: The look on Granny's face when she sees them — y'know, the kind people have when they want to say something but hold back? It's pretty funny.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the flood...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Frankly, I was terrified when the water level started rising! But I didn't even have time to react before Archenoul rushed over and took me away.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Once everything settled down, I thanked her three times, just like grandpa taught me!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I guess only the strong can become a hero like Archenoul, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I have to work hard! I'll run! I'll jump! And I'll swim!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need me to tell her?

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: You know Navia? Awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me think... No, it's okay. Navia is one of those who "have things to do." If I disturb Navia, Grandpa would lecture me again.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: But since you're Navia's friend, you're my friend, too! Have this! I won't take no for an answer!
